title: Manager, Customer Success - Figma Weave (New York, United States)
text:
Figma is growing our team of passionate creatives and builders on a mission to make design accessible to all. Figma’s platform helps teams bring ideas to life—whether you're brainstorming, creating a prototype, translating designs into code, or iterating with AI. From idea to product, Figma empowers teams to streamline workflows, move faster, and work together in real time from anywhere in the world. If you're excited to shape the future of design and collaboration, join us!

We're building the next chapter of AI-native craft and creativity - where craft and technology meet. Our unified platform bridges the gap between AI capabilities and human creativity, and lets professional creatives and designers harness the power of the world’s leading AI models without losing precision, expression, or soul. Together, we’re building tools that help people move faster without sacrificing quality, precision, or craft — a platform where AI supports creativity instead of flattening it.

Our team of Customer Success Managers (CSMs) work closely with some of Figma Weave’s largest customers to drive engagement, adoption, and value realization. Now, we’re looking for an experienced and passionate leader to help scale this function globally.

As the Manager, Customer Success, you will lead a team of CSMs who partner deeply with Weave’s customers. You’ll help shape the strategy of the CSM team, coach and develop individual contributors, and contribute to the broader goals of Weave’s Customer Experience organization. We’re seeking someone who has helped scale post-sales functions in high-growth SaaS environments and is deeply motivated by helping customers succeed and realize business value by using our platform.

If you’re energized by enabling and developing customer-facing teams, and you have a background in SaaS and/or product design and development tools, we’d love to hear from you.

This is a full time role that will be based in our New York hub.

What you’ll do at Figma Weave:

• Lead, manage, and grow a team of high-performing CSMs

• Set clear goals and expectations, provide mentorship and coaching, and support career development

• Partner with Sales, Support, Product, and Marketing to ensure customer needs are met and exceeded

• Refine and scale playbooks and best practices for CSMs

• Drive operational excellence through team processes, tooling, and reporting

• Ensure the team is delivering exceptional value and experience across our enterprise customer base

• Regularly engage directly with customers and act as an escalation point when required (while this is a leadership role, we expect this role to include strong player-coach dynamics)

• Represent the voice of the customer internally and influence product strategy

We'd love to hear from you if you have:

• 3+ years of formal people management experience in Customer Experience, Customer Success, or a similar post-sales function

• 5+ years of total experience in customer-facing roles within high-growth SaaS companies

• A customer-first mindset with strong strategic thinking and execution capabilities

• A proven ability to lead, inspire, and scale teams, especially through growth and change, and a passion for building inclusive, thoughtful, and high-performance team cultures

• Excellent communication skills, with the ability to connect with a wide range of internal and external personas

While it’s not required, it’s an added plus if you also have:

• Familiarity with post-production, creative workflows, or Figma / Weave itself

• Experience in a similar role at a creative, design, collaboration, or productivity-focused SaaS company

• A background in VFX, post-production, Creative, UX/UI, Design Ops, or Frontend Development

At Figma, one of our values is Grow as you go. We believe in hiring smart, curious people who are excited to learn and develop their skills. If you’re excited about this role but your past experience doesn’t align perfectly with the points outlined in the job description, we encourage you to apply anyways. You may be just the right candidate for this or other roles.

Pay Transparency Disclosure

Job level and actual compensation will be decided based on factors including, but not limited to, individual qualifications objectively assessed during the interview process (including skills and prior relevant experience, potential impact, and scope of role), market demands, and specific work location. 

Figma offers equity to employees, as well as a competitive package of additional benefits, including health, dental, and vision coverage; retirement benefits with company contributions; parental leave and reproductive or family planning support; mental health and wellness benefits; and paid time off. Figma provides paid sick leave, holidays, and other leave benefits in compliance with applicable federal, state, and local laws, including the requirements of the Washington Minimum Wage Act and related regulations. title: Accounting Analyst, Content Accounting
text:
Our Global Content Accounting Operations team makes sure the songwriters behind the music on Spotify are accurately accounted for and paid, everywhere in the world. Reporting to the Manager of Content Accounting, you’ll support songwriter royalty accounting globally and partner closely with Legal, Licensing, Technical Accounting, and Engineering. You’ll also help shape what comes next: rolling out claiming processes in new territories as Spotify expands, finding new ways to show the accounting impact of business decisions, steering updates to our claiming systems, and streamlining month-end close in a fast-growing region.

• Execute the monthly global content accounting close, delivering accurate results on time for reporting, including account reconciliations, roll-forward analyses, and insight-driven flux commentary.

• Review licensor claim files and invoices promptly and accurately, meeting all contractual deadlines and flagging discrepancies for resolution.

• Review and interpret legal agreements to ensure royalty payments are calculated and disbursed correctly, and give clear, timely feedback to internal and external stakeholders on royalty calculations and invoice reviews.

• Develop and refine content accounting processes and procedures, and support internal, external, and third-party audit and SOX requirements for your areas of responsibility.

• Partner with Technical Accounting, Finance, Legal, Content, Sales, Sales Operations, FP&A, Billing, AR, IT, Tax, and business owners on policies, processes, and programs, helping drive key system initiatives and improvements.

• Mentor, teach, and review the work of supporting members of the global accounting team, and help our offshore team with questions on invoicing and claims.

• Take part in special projects such as ERP implementation, system enhancements, third-party audits, and ad hoc analyses.

• Travel occasionally and be available for late nights, weekends, or holidays when the close or business needs require it.

Who You Are
• You hold a Bachelor’s degree in Accounting, ideally with a CPA or CA, and have 3+ years of professional experience, with Big 4 or entertainment and media experience a plus.

• You have exceptional time management and organizational skills, with a track record of prioritizing multiple concurrent responsibilities and consistently meeting deadlines.

• You take a proactive approach to problem-solving and continuous process improvement.

• You have advanced Excel skills, experience with ERP systems such as NetSuite, Oracle, or SAP, and proficiency in SQL and BigQuery.

title: Backend Engineer - Data Platform
text:
Every dataset at Spotify, from the data behind creator royalties to the signals powering recommendations, is registered, published and traced through systems our team builds. We're the source of truth for what data exists at Spotify, where it lives, who owns it, and how it flows from one pipeline to the next.

These systems sit on the critical path of the platform. Data teams use them every day to publish and find data, and other platform teams build on them for access, retention, governance and incident response. That means our work is judged on correctness and reliability, because every system built on top of ours is only as good as the metadata we provide.

This is a backend role focused on data management, working on the problems at the core of any large data platform: running a data catalog that stays accurate at scale, capturing lineage across batch and streaming workloads, managing schemas as they evolve, and guaranteeing that consumers only read complete data. We build on open standards like OpenLineage and Apache Iceberg, and define the internal standards for naming, storage and metadata that the rest of Spotify builds against. As the platform takes on new storage technologies and new kinds of data assets, those standards and the systems behind them have to evolve with it, and you'll help decide how.

What You'll Do
• Build and Evolve Core Services: Design, build and operate the backend services and APIs behind our data catalog, lineage and publishing systems, and evolve them as the platform adopts new storage technologies and new kinds of data. Hold them to a high bar for correctness, performance and reliability.

• Build Data Pipelines: Develop and run the batch and streaming pipelines that keep our metadata current, processing platform events and audit logs to capture how data is created and changed, and turning lineage and metadata into data products other teams build on.

• Own Projects End to End: Turn what the teams using our platform need into technical designs, drive them through delivery and rollout, and own the results once they're in production.

• Keep the Platform Healthy: Take part in on-call for critical services, build in observability and quality checks by default, and use automation, including AI tooling, to reduce toil for the team and our users.

Who You Are
• You have solid experience building and running backend services and APIs in production with Java, and you care about API design, versioning and backward compatibility.

• You're comfortable with SQL and have worked with data pipelines or a cloud data warehouse such as BigQuery, Snowflake or Databricks. Hands-on experience with batch or streaming frameworks like Beam, Flink or Spark is a plus.

• You have a working understanding of data engineering concepts such as orchestration, metadata management, data quality, governance and lineage.

• You break problems down into clear, shippable steps, reasoning through tradeoffs and risks and converging on clear recommendations.

• You own the quality of what you ship, including code written with AI assistance, and you care about operating it well after launch.

• You are a strong communicator and collaborator who enjoys working across teams, and you're comfortable in a dynamic platform environment where many engineers depend on what you build and priorities evolve with the business.

Where You'll Be  
• This role is based in Stockholm or London.

• We offer you the flexibility to work where you work best! There will be some in person meetings, but still allows for flexibility to work from home.
Spotify is an equal opportunity employer. You are welcome at Spotify for who you are, no matter where you come from, what you look like, or what’s playing in your headphones. title: Activation Solution Engineer
text:
At Snowflake, we are powering the era of the agentic enterprise. To usher in this new era, we seek AI-native thinkers across every function who are energized by the opportunity to reinvent how they work. Activation Solution Engineer

____

Why Snowflake ?

Snowflakeは、エージェント型エンタープライズの時代を切り拓いています。その実現に向け、あらゆる職種でAIネイティブな発想を持ち、自らの働き方を再定義することに意欲を持つ仲間を求めています。

AIを単なるツールとして使うのではなく、信頼できる協働パートナーとして仕事の中心に取り入れ、好奇心を持って課題解決や成果の加速に活用する方。変化の速い環境を楽しみ、謙虚な姿勢で新しい機能を素早く試し、よりシンプルで効果的な方法を見つけられる方を歓迎します。

Snowflakeで担うのは、担当領域を遂行するだけの役割ではありません。仕事の進め方そのものの未来を、ともに形づくる役割です。

Activation Engineer’s Mission?

Activation Solution Engineerは、新規および導入初期のお客様がSnowflake AI Data Cloudを迅速に活用し、導入から定着、拡大へと進むための技術面を支援する、影響力の大きいクロスファンクショナルなポジションです。AIを活用した最新のツールやコーディングエージェントを駆使し、初期利用の促進と技術的な成功を実現します。

お客様の導入初期における技術面のパートナーとして、短期間での実装と価値創出を支援し、Snowflakeプラットフォームの優れた顧客体験を提供します。初期ユースケースの立ち上げ、アクティベーション、定着に向けた技術イネーブルメントを担います。クラウドデータアーキテクチャの専門性を深めながら、お客様の成功に直接貢献できるポジションです。

The Impact You will Make

• 
担当する新規および導入初期のお客様の技術的な成功と利用拡大を主導し、アカウントごとの導入・利用指標の向上と、価値実現までの時間短縮に責任を持つ。お客様のニーズに対応する窓口として、社内外の関係者をつなぐ。

• 
製品機能の説明にとどまらず、Snowflake AI Data Cloudがお客様のデータ課題をどう解決し、ビジネス価値の最大化につながるかを軸に、成果に基づく利用促進を行う。

• 
契約締結後の早い段階から信頼されるアドバイザーとして、データ戦略や技術スタックとの統合について助言し、ユースケースの迅速かつ円滑な立ち上げを支援する。

• 
AIを活用した開発ツールや自動化を用いて、ソリューション提供や実装支援を効率化し、お客様の本番環境への移行を加速する。

• 
Snowflakeプラットフォーム、データプロダクト、エージェント型ワークフローに関する技術的なガイダンスを提供する。

• 
アカウントチームと協力してリスクを把握し、Snowflake内の各チームや外部パートナーとの信頼関係を築きながら、必要なリソースを適切に連携する。

• 
ハンズオンラボ（HoL）やウェビナーなど、幅広いお客様にプラットフォーム機能や業界のベストプラクティスを伝える、再利用可能で拡張性の高いプログラムを企画・実施する。

お客様の声や現場で得た知見を社内に還元し、プロダクトマネジメントやエンジニアリングチームと連携して製品の進化に貢献する。

お客様向けワークショップ、エグゼクティブ・ブリーフィング、業界イベント、コミュニティミートアップなどでSnowflakeを代表して情報発信を行う。

データテクノロジー領域での実務経験8年以上

• 
モダンデータスタック、ETL／ELT、データウェアハウス／データレイク、データサイエンス、生成AI、データアプリケーションに関する高い技術力

PythonおよびSQLの高度な実務スキル

Apache Spark、PySparkなどの分散コンピューティングフレームワーク、およびdbtなどのモダンデータスタックツールに関する豊富な経験

学び続け、技術力を高め、Snowflakeプラットフォームの専門性を深める意欲
